question: According to Census of India 2011, which group of states of India has the highest population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:-**

 
 
• It alone has a population of over **199 million people**, making it the most populous state in India.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra:-**
 
 
• With a population of over **112 million,** It is the second most populous state in India.
 
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra have the highest population among all Indian states according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• These two states together account for more than **25% of the total population of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arunachal Pradesh **and **Manipur **are among the **least populous states** in India and have a combined population of less than 3 million people.
 
• Similarly,** Bihar, **has a population of around **104 million**, which is **lower** than that of both Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra.
 
• Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, is** incorrect** as it does not include Maharashtra, which has a higher population than Bihar.
